revision_caveat: Older than the local rev 1.2; use conservatively as historical manufacturer guidance, not confirmed requirements for current silicon. Rev 1.2 refers to a separate layout guide.
current_holds: Switching node, main 3.3V input and 1V output power loops remain open; widths, current and stability are not qualified.
C511/C515 bulk positions remain remote. Front-side screening found no isolated C511 position and 16 independent C515 positions; wide power paths are not proven.
XIN now uses two through vias. Oscillator capacitance, frequency margin and coupling to the future switching path require review and physical validation.
C1014 and U23 moved to B.Cu; CPU decoupling and Ethernet ESD return paths are not qualified.
New 0.20 mm bypass branches are topology drafts, not approved primary supply trunks.
resolved_geometry: L501 is now on F.Cu with U5; same-side placement condition addressed geometrically.

experimental_alternative.verified_geometry: Joint compact inductor/bulk placement, grounds restored at original widths, 1.55 mm output branch; five tests passed.
experimental_alternative.remaining: Input, switch node, load distribution, DCR/ripple, effective capacitance and stability qualification.
